facts.text: Zygerria was a temperate, rocky planet, with terrain including plains, mesas, and highlands.

evidence.quote: Zygerria was a temperate, rocky planet, with terrain including plains, mesas, and highlands.

facts.text: The sun on the planet could get quite hot, and thus the streets in the Zygerrian capital were partially covered by colorful awnings.

evidence.quote: The sun on the planet could get quite hot, and thus the streets in the Zygerrian capital were partially covered by colorful awnings.

facts.text: During the Zygerrian Slave Empire's height, the population had fortresses and cities built on top of the mesas scattered throughout the planet, using slave labor.

evidence.quote: During the Zygerrian Slave Empire's height, the population had fortresses and cities built on top of the mesas scattered throughout the planet, using slave labor.

facts.text: Such cities and fortresses were very detailed and consistent in design throughout.

evidence.quote: Such cities and fortresses were very detailed and consistent in design throughout.

facts.text: Many areas or parts of cities were solely used for housing slaves, with regular round-the-clock guard patrols and multiple cells or grates lined in rows below the floor.

evidence.quote: Many areas or parts of cities were solely used for housing slaves, with regular round-the-clock guard patrols and multiple cells or grates lined in rows below the floor.

evidence.quote: Species such as the Togruta species were common for use in places like the Zygerrian Royal Palace.

facts.text: Arenas or stadiums were likewise present throughout cities where fights could be held and bets be placed by onlookers.

evidence.quote: Arenas or stadiums were likewise present throughout cities where fights could be held and bets be placed by onlookers.

facts.text: The planet experienced success during the thousands of years the Zygerrians and their empire maintained a vast slave labor industry, but after the Jedi Order cracked down on the slaving operations, it faded from glory.

evidence.quote: The planet experienced success during the thousands of years the Zygerrians and their empire maintained a vast slave labor industry, but after the Jedi Order cracked down on the slaving operations, it faded from glory.

facts.text: The Old Republic Judicial Forces helped the Jedi to police Zygerria until its slave trade was destroyed.

evidence.quote: The Old Republic Judicial Forces helped the Jedi to police Zygerria until its slave trade was destroyed.

facts.text: However, their empire rose again when the Zygerrians collaborated with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars due to the alliance made between the Queen of Zygerria, Miraj Scintel, and Count Dooku.

evidence.quote: However, their empire rose again when the Zygerrians collaborated with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars due to the alliance made between the Queen of Zygerria, Miraj Scintel, and Count Dooku.

facts.text: This was until Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, and Obi-Wan Kenobi led an operation to locate and rescue a population of Togrutas who went missing, which was later found to be due to a Zygerrian-led operation.

evidence.quote: This was until Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, and Obi-Wan Kenobi led an operation to locate and rescue a population of Togrutas who went missing, which was later found to be due to a Zygerrian-led operation.

facts.text: Zygerria was famous throughout the galaxy for its notorious slave markets and served as the headquarters of the Zygerrian Slavers Guild.

facts.text: Zygerria was a chilly, picturesque world with fortress-capped mesas that extended above windswept plains.

evidence.quote: Zygerria was a chilly, picturesque world with fortress-capped mesas that extended above windswept plains.

facts.text: Graceful brezak creatures caught the wind currents and soared effortlessly from butte to butte.

evidence.quote: Graceful brezak creatures caught the wind currents and soared effortlessly from butte to butte.

facts.text: The deceiving beauty of the planet hid the fact that Zygerria's cities were all built upon the backs of slaves.

evidence.quote: The deceiving beauty of the planet hid the fact that Zygerria's cities were all built upon the backs of slaves.

facts.text: At least as early as 30,000 BBY, Zygerria was under the control of the Infinite Empire, an ancient galaxy-spanning empire ruled by the advanced species Rakata, who hailed from the planet Lehon in the Unknown Regions.

evidence.quote: At least as early as 30,000 BBY, Zygerria was under the control of the Infinite Empire, an ancient galaxy-spanning empire ruled by the advanced species Rakata, who hailed from the planet Lehon in the Unknown Regions.

facts.text: The Rakata used their knowledge to conquer and enslave other species throughout the galaxy until the empire's collapse in 25,200 BBY.

evidence.quote: The Rakata used their knowledge to conquer and enslave other species throughout the galaxy until the empire's collapse in 25,200 BBY.

facts.text: Millennia before the Galactic Empire was proclaimed the Zygerrians subjugated entire planets and civilizations throughout the Outer Rim Territories.

evidence.quote: Millennia before the Galactic Empire was proclaimed the Zygerrians subjugated entire planets and civilizations throughout the Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: Their slaving empire stretched from Argazda down the Salin Corridor and encompassed the entire Triellus Trade Route to Ryloth along the Corellian Run.

evidence.quote: Their slaving empire stretched from Argazda down the Salin Corridor and encompassed the entire Triellus Trade Route to Ryloth along the Corellian Run.

facts.text: The Zygerrian Empire supplied slaves to several Outer Rim powers, including the Chevins of Vinsoth and the sprawling Hutt Empire.

evidence.quote: The Zygerrian Empire supplied slaves to several Outer Rim powers, including the Chevins of Vinsoth and the sprawling Hutt Empire.

facts.text: The Zygerrian Slave Empire grew wealthy and powerful, as did those who exploited their chained subjects.

evidence.quote: The Zygerrian Slave Empire grew wealthy and powerful, as did those who exploited their chained subjects.

facts.text: During the final four years of the Light and Darkness War, Zygerria was situated within the space controlled by the New Sith.

evidence.quote: During the final four years of the Light and Darkness War, Zygerria was situated within the space controlled by the New Sith.

facts.text: When slavery was outlawed in Republic space, the Jedi Knights spearheaded a campaign to abolish slavery in the Outer Rim Territories, which primarily targeted the Zygerrians.

evidence.quote: When slavery was outlawed in Republic space, the Jedi Knights spearheaded a campaign to abolish slavery in the Outer Rim Territories, which primarily targeted the Zygerrians.

facts.text: After a brutal conflict, the Zygerrian Empire fractured, and its power base crumbled.

evidence.quote: After a brutal conflict, the Zygerrian Empire fractured, and its power base crumbled.

evidence.quote: Some Zygerrians actively plotted a return to the old ways and spent millennia rebuilding their empire.

evidence.quote: After the empire's collapse, these buildings remained impressive sights to tourists, bringing visitors even from Alderaan.

evidence.quote: By the time of the Clone Wars, the ruling Queen Miraj Scintel longed for a return to glory for her people and took advantage of a Republic distracted by war to expand the slave trade, allied by the Separatist Alliance.

evidence.quote: The Zygerrians had once again become a dominant force in sentient trafficking, rebranded as the Zygerrian Slavers Guild.

facts.text: With the blessing of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the aid of mercenaries and pirates, the Zygerrians preyed upon helpless star systems isolated by the war.

evidence.quote: With the blessing of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the aid of mercenaries and pirates, the Zygerrians preyed upon helpless star systems isolated by the war.

facts.text: In 20 BBY, after the ruthless Prime Minister of Zygerria Atai Molec overthrew the Queen Scintel and assumed the throne, the Zygerrian Slave Empire was reborn.

evidence.quote: In 20 BBY, after the ruthless Prime Minister of Zygerria Atai Molec overthrew the Queen Scintel and assumed the throne, the Zygerrian Slave Empire was reborn.

evidence.quote: Barring setbacks during the Imperial reconquest of the Rim, when the Imperial fleet proceeded to besiege Zygerria and forced the Zygerrians to negotiate peace with an Imperial advisor.
